name: n8n
tagline: n8n is an open-source workflow automation platform that lets developers and technical teams build complex automations with full code access and self-hosting control. Unlike Zapier or Make, n8n runs on your own infrastructure, keeping data inside your environment, which matters for compliance-sensitive workflows. Its 350+ native integrations and AI-native nodes make it a favourite for technically minded teams building serious automation.
